technical-data.invention-title: GUIDE DE FORAGE ET DE FILETAGE

nplcit.text: PATENT ABSTRACTS OF JAPAN & JP 01 121 113 A (TOSHINORI KIYOTA) 05 December 1989

abstract.p: The invention relates to a drilling and thread-cutting guide (1) comprising a guide unit (3) which can be fixed in position on a workpiece (2) and at its lower part (4) has support position (5). The guide unit (3) cooperates with a guide sleeve (6) inserted therein and having an inner diameter matching the working tool (7) to be used, said support portion (5) being constituted by a mounting piece (8) which can be mounted on the workpiece for the double purpose of both supporting the guide unit (3) and retaining it in a fixed position.

Cette invention se rapporte à un guide de forage et de filetage (1), comprenant une unité guide (3) qui peut être fixée en position immobile sur une pièce à usiner (2) et qui comporte dans sa partie inférieure (4) un élément de support (5). L'unité guide (3) coopère avec un manchon de guidage (6) introduit dans ladite unité et possédant un diamètre interne correspondant à celui de l'outil d'usinage (7) devant être utilisé, l'élément de support (5) étant constitué d'une pièce de montage (8) qui peut être montée sur la pièce à usiner pour assurer la double fonction de soutien de l'unité guide (3) et de maintien de celle-ci dans une position fixe.

description.p: Drill- and thread guide
The present invention relates to a drilling and threading guide device comprising a guide unit which can be fixed in position on a workpiece and includes a support portion at its lower part .

I thas been found difficult, when performing drilling or cutting threads, exactly to locate in its described position the hole to be drilled in a workpiece . It is especially troublesome when the hole to be drilled or threaded is located in a corner or when it is inclined by 45°C. The same problem arises when the workpiece has concave or convex surfaces.

The object of the present invention is to provide a device for guiding a drilling or thread-cutting operation at which the above mentioned problems have been eliminated. The features characterizng the invention are set out in the claims.

Accordingly, the drilling and thread-cutting device of the invention facilitates the work when the hole to be drilled must be oriented with an inclination angle of exactly 90° or 43 relatively a flat surface or when it is located at a corner of different types of workpieces. Furhter, the device can be provided with different kinds of adapters when the drilling is carried out through e.g. concave or convex surfaces. When the drilling operation is performed in wood, it is also possible to use an adapter particularly designed for that purpose . The drilling and thread-cutting guide device has a guide unit that can be inserted into different guide sleeves the inner diameters of which are matching the outer diameter of the tool used, whereby one does obtain an exact positioning of a drill or screw tap used to machine the workpiece .

As soon as the guide sleeve to be used has been placed in position in the guide unit of the drilling and thread-cutting device, the drill can be moved through the sleeve into contact
with the workpiece making it possible to perform a very exact and straight working operation.

Once the guide unit has been put in place on the workpiece selection of other guide sleeves can be made. By way of example, a drill sleeve can be replaced by a thread-cutting sleeve etc, resulting in an exact working operation, since there is no need to move the guide unit in order to change the sleeve. Consequently, the end result is that the hole and the threads will be completely coaxial .
Some embodiments of the invention will now be described with reference to the drawing.

Fig. 15 is a diagrammatic, lateral view of an adapter to be used for wooden workpieces and provided with an extension permitting it to be fixed in position with the end of a clump, not shown in the drawing.

As appears from the drawing, especially from its figs. 1-5, there has been shown a preferred embodiment of the invention in the shape of a drilling and thread-cutting guide device 1 comprising a guide unit 3 which can be fixed in position on a workpiece 2 and exhibits a support portion 5 at its lower part 4. The guide unit 3 cooperates with a guide sleeve 6, which can be inserted into the unit and the inner diameter of which matches the machining tool, that is to be used e.g. a drill 7. The support portion 5 is constituted by a mounting piece 8 which can be mounted on the workpiece 2 and does both support the guide unit 3 and hold it in position. In this way a working operation can be carried out in exactly the predetermined position on the workpiece 2.

The mounting piece 8, constituting the support portion 5, has at least one magnet 9, which is countersunk in its bottom surface 10 and, thanks to the shape of mounting piece 8, holds the drilling and thread-cutting guide fixed in position on the workpiece 2 which in this example consists of metal.

In order to facilitate the release of the drilling and thread- cutting guide from the workpiece 2 mounting piece 8, constituting the support portion 5, comprises means 22 for lifting the drilling and thread-cutting guide. Those means 22 are constituted by a pin 21 located at and extending through the circumpherential portion of mounting piece 8 and which, by means of a lever having an oval pressure section, can be displaced towards and into contact with the workpiece. The support 5 of the drilling and thread-cutting guide does also include a ring-shaped magnet 9 countersunk in its bottom surface 10.

In the embodiment shown in figs. 6-9 the support portion 5 consists of two support plates 14, 15, oriented at an angle between them and comprising inclined contact surfaces which are
to contact the workpiece 2 ' . The magnet is here in the shape of elongated rods 16, 17 countersunk in the bottom 10' of mounting piece 8.

In the embodiment shown in figs. 10-12 the mounting piece 8 consists of three support plates 18-20 with contact surfaces mounted at angles to match the angles of a workpiece 2 ' ' . Each support plate 18-20 has its own magnet 23.

In figs. 13-16 there is shown an adapter 11 for fixation of the drilling and thread-cutting guide on a wooden workpiece. The adapter 11 consists of a support plate 24 which exhibits either pins 25 which can be pushed into the wood surface, or an extension 26 by means of which the adapter, and its mounted drilling and thread-cutting guide 1 can be fixed in position. The adapter 11 has a metal ring 28 countersunk in a recess 27 for cooperation with that or those magnets which are located in the mounting piece 8 of the drilling and thread-cutting guide 1 (see fig. 1) . In those cases when the adapter 11 is made in a metallic material, this ring can be omitted.

When the drilling and thread-cutting guide is to be used for drilling and/or thread-cutting in convex surfaces use is made of an adapter 12, shown more in detail in figs. 17-19. In fig. 17 the adapter 12 has a somewhat greater diameter than that of the adapter 13 shown in fig. 18. The adapters 12, 13 have knob means 29 intended to cooperate with corresponding recesses 30 in the mounting piece 8 of the drilling and thread-cutting guide 1. When concave surfaces are to be machined use is made of an adapter having a convex shape .

claim.claim-text: 1. A drilling and thread-cutting guide comprising a guide unit (3) which can be fixed on a workpiece (2) and at its lower part (4) has a support portion (5) and can receive a guide sleeve (6) the inner diameter of which matches the machining tool (7) , characterized in that the support portion (5) is constituted by a mounting piece (8) that can be secured to the workpiece (2) in order to support the guide unit (3) and also to retain it in position, said mounting piece (8) having at least one magnet (9) countersunk in its bottom surface (10) whereby the mounting piece (8) retains the drilling and thread- cutting guide (1) in position on either a metallic workpiece or on an adapter (11-13) designed to retain the drilling and thread-cutting guide (1) fixed in position on convex and concave surfaces and at wooden workpieces, the mounting piece (8) having one configuration for flat surfaces, constituted by a support plate (24) having a flat surface in contact with a workpiece, one for angled surfaces which comprises two support plates (14, 15), matching the angle in question and having angled contact surfaces, and one for corners comprising three support plates (18-20) matching the angles in question and having angled contact surfaces so that, on the workpiece concerned a working operation can be carried out exactly in the predetermined position.

2. A guide as claimed in claim 1, characterized in that the mounting piece (8) , forming the support portion (5) , includes means (22) adapted to lift the drilling and thread-cutting guide (1) from the workpiece and/or from the adapter.

3. A guide as claimed in claim 1, characterized in in that the adapter (12; 13) for convex and concave surfaces has a diameter, matching the convex or concave shape of the workpiece, and knob means (29) for cooperation with corresponding recesses (30) in the mounting piece (8) of the drilling and thread-cutting guide (1) in order by magnetic power to
retain those parts fixed in position.
4. A guide as claimed in claim 1, characterized in that the adapter (11) used to hold the drilling and thread-cutting guide

(1) fixed in position on a wooden workpiece is constituted by a support plate (24) exhibiting either pins (25) , which can be pushed into the wooden surface, or an extension (26) permitting the adapter (11) and the drilling and thread-cutting guide (1) by means of a damp to be held in position on the workpiece.

5. A guide as claimed in claim 2, characterized in that the lifting means (22) of the mounting piece (8) consist of pins (21) which are located on and can pass through the circumferential part of the mounting piece (8) and which by means of a lever, having an ovally shaped pressure position, can actuate a workpiece or adapter.
